items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I did most of it and Joe Artis (phonetic spelling) Corporation

ctx.x: After the Willard Alexander, John Hammond thing kind of played out, who booked your band those years after that?
Numerous others, I'd say, to tell you the truth, ten. Maybe that's why I didn't get any higher. I did most of it and Joe Artis (phonetic spelling) Corporation

did quite a bit of booking for me, and then this negro agency, Ferguson Brothers out of Indiana did quite a bit. I think Clarence Love had introduced--had recommended them--and they did some booking. During that time I did a short tour with Helen Humes, she was a feature.
